title: 5th International Quran Conference 2026 - Ahlul Quran Foundation
description: Ahlul Quran Foundation presents the 5th International Quran Conference - Sunday, 4th October 2026 at the International Conference Centre, University of Ibadan, Nigeria. Theme: The Quran and the Reformation of the Ummah. Join scholars, reciters, and community for a day of knowledge and dialogue.
